import hashlib,json,pathlib,subprocess
p=pathlib.Path('udt_gw170817_fixed_window_test_campaign_2026-09-07')
git=['git','-c','core.preloadIndex=false']
r=subprocess.run(git+['diff','--cached','--check'],capture_output=True,text=True)
rows=r.stdout.splitlines()
expected={'INITIAL_independent_math.py':82,'INITIAL_independent_operator.py':76,'INITIAL_independent_replay.py':232,'PRE_R1_independent_replay.py':237,'PRE_REPAIR_independent_replay.py':237}
want={str(p/'step_02/review'/name)+':'+str(line)+': new blank line at EOF.' for name,line in expected.items()}
assert r.returncode==2 and set(rows)==want and len(rows)==5 and r.stderr==''
manifest={}
for line in (p/'SHA256SUMS').read_text().splitlines():
 h,name=line.split('  ',1);manifest[name]=h
for name in expected:
 f=p/'step_02/review'/name
 assert hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==manifest[str(f)]
files=[str(q) for q in p.rglob('*') if q.is_file() and '__pycache__' not in q.parts and q.suffix!='.pyc']
staged=set(subprocess.check_output(git+['diff','--cached','--name-only'],text=True).splitlines())
assert staged==set(files+['LIVE.md','HANDOFF.md','CURRENT_RESEARCH_PROGRAM.md'])
names=sorted(x for x in subprocess.check_output(git+['status','--short'],text=True).splitlines() if x.startswith('?? '))
nh=hashlib.sha256('\n'.join(names).encode()).hexdigest()
assert len(names)==46 and nh=='d65d71d63a56b95aabfd61f33317b1f1f2b2a62a85ded8258c525b99a5e156ea'
print(json.dumps(dict(scope='exact staged formatting exception and allowlist audit; not scientific review',normal_cached_whitespace_check_returncode=r.returncode,raw_stdout=r.stdout,raw_stderr=r.stderr,disposition='EXACT DOCUMENTED FORMATTING EXCEPTION, not ordinary PASS: preserve five byte-pinned initial reviewer snapshots including trailing blank lines; no scientific code or global rule changed',original_snapshot_hashes_match=True,other_whitespace_errors=False,staged_authorized_files=len(staged),unrelated_names=len(names),unrelated_name_hash=nh),indent=2))
